newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh awards Petronas 5.92 mln brls oil deal.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh awards Petronas 5.92 mln brls oil deal.

text.p: State-owned Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation (BPC) said on Wednesday it awarded a six-month, $194 million contract to supply 5.92 million barrels of petroleum products to Petronas Trading Corporation of Malaysia.

The state-owned Petronas Trading Corporation would supply the products during the January to June period, BPC officials said. The cargo includes superior kerosene oil, motor spirit, aviation turbine fuel and high speed diesel, they said. They would not give a breakdown of the rates or other details.
The officials said the deal had been awarded to the company following a bidding held on December 3.
